title: Why Cities Need More Bike Lanes
text:
Many cities have too many cars on their streets. Traffic makes the air dirty and can be dangerous for people. Bike lanes give cyclists their own space on the road. For these reasons, cities should build more bike lanes.

Some drivers say that bike lanes take space away from cars. However, cyclists also help the city by reducing traffic jams. People who ride bikes are usually healthier, and they spend less money on fuel. A city that is safer for cyclists is a better place for everyone.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, what does traffic do to the air?
options: It has no effect on the air.

questions.text: According to paragraph two, what do cyclists help the city do?
Why does the writer think bike lanes are important?
options: They make cycling safer and better for the city.
They are cheaper than all other roads.
They allow cars to go faster.
They remove the need for buses.

questions.text: What is the writer's main purpose in this passage?
options: To persuade readers that cities should build more bike lanes.
To explain how to repair a bicycle.
To tell a story about a trip to a park.
To describe the history of cars.

paragraph_translations: Muchas ciudades tienen demasiados coches en sus calles. El tráfico ensucia el aire y puede ser peligroso para las personas. Los carriles para bicicletas dan a los ciclistas su propio espacio en la carretera. Por estas razones, las ciudades deberían construir más carriles para bicicletas.

Algunos conductores dicen que los carriles para bicicletas quitan espacio a los coches. Sin embargo, los ciclistas también ayudan a la ciudad al reducir los atascos. Las personas que andan en bicicleta suelen estar más saludables y gastan menos dinero en combustible. Una ciudad más segura para los ciclistas es un mejor lugar para todos.
